qe: How many base quantities are there in the International System of Units (SI), and which of the following is NOT one of them?
qh: अंतर्राष्ट्रीय मात्रक प्रणाली (SI) में कितनी मूल राशियाँ हैं, तथा निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सी उनमें सम्मिलित नहीं है?
oe: Seven; electric current is not a base quantity
Seven; luminous intensity is not a base quantity
Nine; amount of substance is not a base quantity
Seven; plane angle is not a base quantity
oh: सात; विद्युत धारा मूल राशि नहीं है
सात; ज्योति तीव्रता मूल राशि नहीं है
नौ; पदार्थ की मात्रा मूल राशि नहीं है
सात; समतल कोण मूल राशि नहीं है
e: SI pranali me saat mool raashiyan (base quantities) hain aur unke saat mool matrak: lambai ka metre, dravyaman ka kilogram, samay ka second, vidyut dhara ka ampere, tapaman ka kelvin, padarth ki matra ka mole tatha jyoti teevrta ka candela. Vidyut dhara, jyoti teevrta tatha padarth ki matra - teeno is sauchi suchi ka hissa hain, isliye unhe 'mool raashi nahi' kehna galat hai. Plane angle (samatal kon) SI me 'supplementary unit' hai jiska matrak radiant hai; isi tarah solid angle ka matrak steradian hai. Rashtriya SI me saat mool matrakon ke alava vyutpann matrak (derived units) hote hain, jaise newton (bal), joule (urja), watt (shakti) tatha pascal (dabav). Isliye samatal kon mool raashiyon me nahi ginte - yahi is prashn ka sahi uttar hai. Exam point: SI ke saat mool matrak = metre, kilogram, second, ampere, kelvin, mole, candela; samatal kon tatha thos kon supplementary units hain (radian, steradian).

qe: 'Light year' is a unit of which physical quantity?
qh: 'प्रकाश वर्ष' (light year) किस भौतिक राशि का मात्रक है?
e: Naam me 'year' (varsh) hone ke kaaran bahut se vidyarthi light year ko samay ka matrak samajh lete hain, lekin yah galat hai. Light year ek dURi ka matrak hai - yah woh doori hai jo prakash ek varsh me nirvaat (vacuum) me tay karta hai. Ganna aasan hai: prakash ki chaal lagbhag 3 lakh kilometre prati second hoti hai, isliye ek varsh (365 din) me prakash karib 9.46 laakh crore kilometre (9.46 x 10^12 km) tay karta hai. Khagol vigyan me doori itni badi hoti hai ki kilometre me likhna mushkil ho jaata hai, isliye light year, parsec tatha astronomical unit (AU) ka prayog hota hai. Speed of light ek chaal hai jiska matrak metre prati second hota hai, light year nahi. Isliye light year ke 'year' shabd se dhokha na khayein; yah kaale samay ke bajaye doori batata hai. Exam point: light year = doori ka matrak (ek varsh me prakash dwara tay doori, karib 9.46 x 10^12 km); AU = prithvi se sooraj ki ausat doori; parsec = doori ka badi ikai.

qe: The instrument used to measure the relative humidity of air is:
qh: वायु की आपेक्षिक आर्द्रता (relative humidity) मापने वाला यंत्र है -
e: Hygrometer ek yantra hai jo hawa me jal-vashp (water vapour) ki matra, yaani aapekshik aardrata (relative humidity) maapta hai; mausam-vigyan me yah bahut kaam aata hai aur kheti tatha swasthya dono ke liye mahatvapurn hai. Barometer wayumandalik dabav (atmospheric pressure) maapta hai - jise aksar log hygrometer samajh lete hain, lekin dono alag hain. Anemometer hawa ki chaal (wind speed) maapta hai, isliye yah bhi is prashn ka jawab nahi hai; hawa ki disha ke liye wind vane ka prayog hota hai. Hydrometer drav ke ghanatva (density) ya vishesh gurutva (specific gravity) nikaalne me kaam aata hai - doodh ki shuddhta jaanchne wala yantra isi ka vishesh roop lactometer hai. Isliye sahi uttar hygrometer hai aur baaki teen yantra doosri maatraaon se jude hain. Exam point: hygrometer = aapekshik aardrata; barometer = wayumandalik dabav; anemometer = hawa ki chaal; hydrometer = drav ka ghanatva (lactometer = doodh ki shuddhta).

qe: Which of the following pairs of measuring instruments is correctly matched?
qh: मापन यंत्रों के निम्नलिखित युग्मों में कौन-सा सही सुमेलित है?
e: Sphygmomanometer woh yantra hai jisse dhmaniyon (arteries) ka raktchaap (blood pressure) maapa jaata hai; isme ek rubber cuff hota hai jo bhujaa par baandha jaata hai aur uske reading se systolic-dystolic dabav pata chalta hai. Seismograph bhookamp ki tivrta aur jhatke record karta hai, pawan ki chaal nahi, isliye doosri jodi galat hai (pawan ki chaal ke liye anemometer). Lactometer doodh ka ghanatva ya shuddhta naapta hai, rakt shakara (blood sugar) nahi; rakt shakara ke liye glucometer ka prayog hota hai. Galvanometer bahut chhoti vidyut dhara tatha uski disha batata hai; bhookamp ke aakde ke liye woh kaam nahi aata. Is tarah pehli jodi hi sahi hai; baaki teeno jodiyan galat yantra se judi hain. Exam point: raktchaap = sphygmomanometer, bhookamp = seismograph, pawan chaal = anemometer, rakt shakara = glucometer, chhoti dhara = galvanometer.

qe: Which of the following is a derived SI unit?
qh: निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा व्युत्पन्न SI मात्रक है?
e: SI ke saat mool matrak hain - metre, kilogram, second, ampere, kelvin, mole tatha candela. Ampere vidyut dhara ka mool matrak, kelvin tapaman ka mool matrak tatha mole padarth ki matra ka mool matrak hai; isliye teeno vikalp is prashn se mel nahi khate. Newton ek vyutpann (derived) matrak hai jo bal naapta hai aur ise mool matrakon se banaya jaata hai: ek newton = ek kilogram-metre prati second ka varg (kg-m/s^2), yaani jo bal ek kilogram dravyaman par ek metre prati second ke ek varg wala tvaran utpann kare. Isi tarah joule (urja), watt (shakti), pascal (dabav) aur volt bhi vyutpann matrak hain. Vyutpann matrakon ka matlab yah hai ki woh mool matrakon ke gunan-phal tatha bhaag se nikalte hain, apne aap independent nahi hote. Exam point: mool matrak = 7; vyutpann matrak = newton (bal), joule (urja), watt (shakti), pascal (dabav); newton = kg m s^-2.

qe: One astronomical unit (AU), used to express distances within the solar system, is equal to approximately:
qh: सौरमंडल के भीतर की दूरियाँ बताने में प्रयुक्त एक खगोलीय मात्रक (AU) लगभग किसके बराबर है?
oe: The distance of the Moon from the Earth
The average distance of the Earth from the Sun
The distance light travels in one year
The diameter of the Milky Way galaxy
oh: पृथ्वी की सूर्य से औसत दूरी
एक वर्ष में प्रकाश द्वारा तय दूरी
e: Astronomical unit (khagoliya matrak) paas wali duriyon ko likhne ka sabse suvidhajanak tareeka hai. Ek AU prithvi ki sooraj se ausat (average) doori ke barabar hota hai, jo lagbhag 15 crore kilometre (1.496 x 10^8 km) hai. Isi AU me sooraj se grahon ki doori likhi jaati hai - budh karib 0.39 AU, prithvi 1 AU, tatha neptune karib 30 AU par hai. Prithvi tatha chandrama ke beech ki ausat doori lagbhag 3.84 lakh kilometre hoti hai, jo ek AU ka chhota hissa hai, isliye pehla vikalp galat hai. Ek varsh me prakash dwara tay ki gayi doori 'light year' kehlati hai, jo AU se lagbhag 63,000 guna badi hai; isliye teesra vikalp galat hai. Milky Way ka vyaas karib 1 lakh light year hota hai - woh aur bhi bahut bada aakda hai. Exam point: 1 AU = prithvi-sooraj ki ausat doori karib 15 crore km; sooraj ke sabse nikat grah budh ki doori 0.39 AU; light year aur AU alag ikaiyaan hain.
